senses.gloss: f. (גרר, v. גִּירָא II) a shoot, stalk (of flax or asparagus). Mekh. Mshp., N’zikin, s. 13 המערב את הג׳ בתלתן (Var. גֵּירָה, גררה) he who mixes (other) stalks among stalks of fenugrec; Yalk. Ex. 343; Tosef. B. Kam. VII, 8 גידה ed. Zuck. (Var. גירה, גורה). [Löw Pfl. p. 317: seed of St. John’s bread among seeds of fenugrec.]
